CREDIT DECISION SUMMARY
========================================
Model Assessment: LOW RISK — unlikely to default
Estimated Default Probability: 46.7%
Decision Threshold: 50%

IMPORTANT: This is a statistical model score, not a guarantee. The model estimates a 46.7% probability of serious delinquency within two years based on the provided credit data. Actual outcomes depend on many factors not captured by this model.

KEY FACTORS DRIVING THIS ASSESSMENT
========================================

1. REVOLVING CREDIT UTILIZATION (THE SHARE OF AVAILABLE CREDIT IN USE)
   Observed value : 48.4%
   Risk impact    : This factor increases the estimated default risk (+0.341).
   Interpretation : A utilization of 48.4% means the applicant is using a significant portion of available revolving credit. High utilization is one of the strongest predictors of default risk.

2. NUMBER OF REAL ESTATE LOANS OR MORTGAGES
   Observed value : 3
   Risk impact    : This factor increases the estimated default risk (+0.258).
   Interpretation : 3 real estate loan(s). These loans contribute to the overall debt profile.

3. NUMBER OF OPEN CREDIT LINES AND LOANS
   Observed value : 13
   Risk impact    : This factor increases the estimated default risk (+0.183).
   Interpretation : 13 open credit lines. A higher number may indicate over-leveraging.

RECOURSE RECOMMENDATIONS
========================================
The model currently assesses this applicant as low risk. No recourse action is needed at this time. Maintaining current financial habits is recommended.
